nights.title: Cem Adrian
nights.name: Cem Adrian
nights.extract: Cem Filiz, better known by his stage name Cem Adrian, is a Turkish musician of Bosniak descent, singer-songwriter and record producer.

nights.title: The Blasting Company
nights.name: The Blasting Company
nights.extract: The Blasting Company, formerly known as the Petrojvic Blasting Company, is an American nouveau-folk band based in Los Angeles, California. The band was founded in 2008 by half-brothers Justin Rubenstein and J.R. Kaufman, with the group expanding to anywhere from five to ten members later.

nights.title: George Clanton
nights.name: George Clanton
nights.extract: George Wayland Clanton Jr., also known by the monikers Mirror Kisses, ESPRIT 空想, CHINA, and Kid's Garden, is an American electronic musician and singer-songwriter that emerged from the vaporwave music scene in the early 2010s. He established his independent record label 100% Electronica in 2015, and in 2019 launched the first vaporwave music festival, 100% ElectroniCON.

nights.title: SIX60
nights.name: Six60
nights.extract: Six60 is a New Zealand pop rock band formed in Dunedin, Otago in 2008. The band consists of Matiu Walters, Ji Fraser, Chris Mac, and Marlon Gerbes.
